On April 28, Mnet confirmed that Park Jin Young (J.Y. Park), Aliya Janell, and Mike Song will serve as the judges for World of Street Woman Fighter.

World of Street Woman Fighter marks the third season of Mnet’s hit dance competition series Street Woman Fighter. This season will feature a five-country showdown with teams representing South Korea, New Zealand, the United States, Japan, and Australia. A total of six crews will compete: AG SQUAD, BUMSUP, MOTIV, OSAKA Ojo Gang, RHTokyo, and ROYAL FAMILY.

Park Jin Young, the head of JYP Entertainment and a renowned singer-producer, has built an illustrious career since his debut in 1994, creating countless hit songs. Known for his passion and dedication to dance, he has consistently delivered top-tier music and performances, earning his status as a living legend in the Korean music industry.



World-renowned choreographer Aliya Janell has also joined the panel as a judge. A former lead dancer for Beyoncé’s tour and the choreographer behind Hyolyn’s hits “Dally” and “Wait,” Aliya is expected to bring invaluable insight and global flair to the competition.



Another major addition is Mike Song, often hailed as the dancer of dancers. As the leader of the world-famous dance crew Kinjaz, Mike Song has already left a strong impression as a special judge on “Street Man Fighter” and “Street Woman Fighter 2.” With his unmatched dance skills and seasoned judging experience, he is anticipated to create outstanding synergy with this new season.



The production team commented, Since this new chapter is an international competition, our preparations have been especially thorough. With Park Jin Young, who is deeply passionate about dance, world-class choreographer Aliya Janell, and dancers' dancer Mike Song joining as fight judges, we hope viewers will look forward to the powerful synergy they will bring to ‘World of Street Woman Fighter.’

“World of Street Woman Fighter” will premiere on May 27 at 10 p.m. KST.

                                    <div class="info-emphasis right"><span>by</span> <span class="strong emphasis base-size"><a title="Articles by M Lim" href="https://www.soompi.com/author/8404462wpa">M Lim</a></span></div>

                                                                                   <p>Mnet’s “<a target="_blank" href="https://www.soompi.com/article/1732821wpp/watch-world-of-street-woman-fighter-unveils-star-studded-crew-lineup-and-premiere-date">World of Street Woman Fighter</a>” has officially announced its fight judge lineup!</p>
<p>On April 28, Mnet confirmed that <a href="https://www.viki.com/celebrities/14799pr?utm_source=soompi&utm_medium=tvfilm&utm_campaign=world-of-street-woman-fighter-unveils-judge-lineup&utm_content_id=1740129wpp" onclick="javascript:_gaq.push(['_trackEvent','outbound-article','http://www.viki.com']);"target="_blank" >Park Jin Young</a> (J.Y. Park), Aliya Janell, and Mike Song will serve as the judges for “World of Street Woman Fighter.”</p>
<p>“World of Street Woman Fighter” marks the third season of Mnet’s hit dance competition series “Street Woman Fighter.” This season will feature a five-country showdown with teams representing South Korea, New Zealand, the United States, Japan, and Australia. A total of six crews will compete: AG SQUAD, BUMSUP, MOTIV, OSAKA Ojo Gang, RHTokyo, and ROYAL FAMILY.</p>
<p>Park Jin Young, the head of JYP Entertainment and a renowned singer-producer, has built an illustrious career since his debut in 1994, creating countless hit songs. Known for his passion and dedication to dance, he has consistently delivered top-tier music and performances, earning his status as a “living legend” in the Korean music industry.</p>
<p><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-1740131" src="https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043052/wswf-jyp.jpeg" alt="" width="1024" height="1280" srcset="https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043052/wswf-jyp.jpeg 1080w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043052/wswf-jyp.jpeg 300w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043052/wswf-jyp.jpeg 768w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043052/wswf-jyp.jpeg 540w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></p>
<p>World-renowned choreographer Aliya Janell has also joined the panel as a judge. A former lead dancer for Beyoncé’s tour and the choreographer behind <a target="_blank" href="https://www.viki.com/celebrities/14384pr-hyolyn?utm_source=soompi&utm_medium=tvfilm&utm_campaign=world-of-street-woman-fighter-unveils-judge-lineup&utm_content_id=1740129wpp">Hyolyn</a>’s hits “Dally” and “Wait,” Aliya is expected to bring invaluable insight and global flair to the competition.</p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-1740130" src="https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043042/wswf-aliya-janell.jpeg" alt="" width="1024" height="1280" srcset="https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043042/wswf-aliya-janell.jpeg 1080w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043042/wswf-aliya-janell.jpeg 300w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043042/wswf-aliya-janell.jpeg 768w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043042/wswf-aliya-janell.jpeg 540w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></p>
<p>Another major addition is Mike Song, often hailed as “the dancer of dancers.” As the leader of the world-famous dance crew Kinjaz, Mike Song has already left a strong impression as a special judge on “Street Man Fighter” and “Street Woman Fighter 2.” With his unmatched dance skills and seasoned judging experience, he is anticipated to create outstanding synergy with this new season.</p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-1740132" src="https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043102/wswf-mike-song.jpeg" alt="" width="1024" height="1280" srcset="https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043102/wswf-mike-song.jpeg 1080w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043102/wswf-mike-song.jpeg 300w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043102/wswf-mike-song.jpeg 768w, https://0.soompi.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/28043102/wswf-mike-song.jpeg 540w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></p>
<p>The production team commented, “Since this new chapter is an international competition, our preparations have been especially thorough. With Park Jin Young, who is deeply passionate about dance, world-class choreographer Aliya Janell, and dancers’ dancer Mike Song joining as fight judges, we hope viewers will look forward to the powerful synergy they will bring to ‘World of Street Woman Fighter.’”</p>
<p>“World of Street Woman Fighter” will premiere on May 27 at 10 p.m. KST.</p>
